arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT"<p."STRT_DT" or h."POST_DT">p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT") order by 1

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_DT", s.dr, s.cr, s.n from "APINVH" i left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr, count(*) n from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO") s on s."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where s."JRNL_NO" is null or s.dr<>i."INV_AMT" or s.cr<>i."INV_AMT" order by 1

select "JRNL_NO", "LN_SEQ", "ACCT_CD", "DR_AMT", "CR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l where not exists (select 1 from "GLCOA" c where trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") and c."ACTV_FLG"='Y') or ("DR_AMT"=0 and "CR_AMT"=0) order by 1
select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by "JRNL_NO" having sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")
